headline: Sand truck overturns in Kurigram, rail communication cut off nationwide
summary: A sand-laden truck overturned on the railway line in Kurigram, disrupting train services across the country.
details: A sand-laden truck overturned on the railway tracks in Kurigram, causing a complete halt to rail communication across the country.
The accident occurred when the truck, carrying a heavy load of sand, lost balance and flipped over directly onto the lines.
Railway authorities and emergency teams are working to remove the vehicle and clear the the tracks to restore services.
The disruption has left numerous passengers stranded and caused significant delays to train schedules nationwide.

headline_marked: Kidnapped 5-year-old [[found dead in Patiya]] after ransom demand
headline: Kidnapped 5-year-old found dead in Patiya after ransom demand
summary: The child's body was recovered from a pond beside a neighbor's house; three neighbors have been detained for questioning.
details: A 5-year-old boy named Md Zayan was found dead early Thursday morning in Chattogram's Patiya, hours after a ransom note demanding Tk 300,000 was discovered.
The child's body was recovered from a pond beside a neighbor's house in Dakshin Gobindarkhil village.
Ziaul Haque, chief of Patiya Police Station, stated that the body had injury marks on the head, and three neighbors have been taken into custody for questioning.
Zayan, the son of garage owner Md Shahjahan, had gone missing from outside his home on Wednesday afternoon.
Around 3:30 pm on Wednesday, Shahjahan found a handwritten note inside his house demanding the ransom and warning that the boy would be killed if police were informed.
The note instructed the family to leave the cash and an unlocked phone in a bag at a broken roadside shop near their home.
Investigators are currently looking into a land dispute between the victim's family and the neighboring household where the body was found as a potential motive.
caption:
A 5-year-old boy found dead in a pond after a Tk 300,000 ransom demand.

A 5-year-old boy named Md Zayan was found dead early Thursday morning in Chattogram's Patiya, hours after a ransom note demanding Tk 300,000 was discovered.

The child's body was recovered from a pond beside a neighbor's house in Dakshin Gobindarkhil village.

Ziaul Haque, chief of Patiya Police Station, stated that the body had injury marks on the head, and three neighbors have been taken into custody for questioning.

Zayan, the son of garage owner Md Shahjahan, had gone missing from outside his home on Wednesday afternoon.

Around 3:30 pm on Wednesday, Shahjahan found a handwritten note inside his house demanding the ransom and warning that the boy would be killed if police were informed.

The note instructed the family to leave the cash and an unlocked phone in a bag at a broken roadside shop near their home.

Investigators are currently looking into a land dispute between the victim's family and the neighboring household where the body was found as a potential motive.
